Core Capabilities
 

The “we got you” button for your business

 

You’re not selling a website. You’re selling calm operations and owned revenue.

 
 
 
 
  
 
 Branded Ordering Storefront 
 
 Mobile-first menu and catalog with customization, cart, and checkout — your name on the order, not a marketplace’s. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Kitchen & Ops Calm 
 
 Kitchen display, live status flow, busy mode, and assignment — orders land where work happens, not buried in a phone. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Notified on the Spot 
 
 Confirmation and status updates the moment something changes — received → preparing → ready → completed. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Delivery, Pickup & Dine-In 
 
 Fulfillment modes the business actually runs — plus reservations, multi-location hours, and delivery hooks when you need wheels. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Payments & Coupons 
 
 Clear checkout, configurable payment methods, campaign codes, and accounting-friendly exports — not cash-in-a-jar folklore. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Reports That Don’t Lie 
 
 Orders over time, top items, coupon performance, location comparisons, and visitor insights you can act on. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Automations & Webhooks 
 
 New order → kitchen + customer. Status change → SMS. Busy mode → pause checkout. Connect CRM, Slack, and partners. 
 
 
 
  
 
 Grow Beyond Food 
 
 Digital products, gift vouchers, subscriptions, memberships, and social campaign pages — same customers, more revenue lanes.

FAQ

 
 
  Isn’t this just another menu website?     
 No. Ordelo is ordering HQ: cart, payments, kitchen display, notifications, reports, and room to grow into subscriptions and digital products — not a brochure with a phone number. 
 
 
  We already get orders on WhatsApp. Why switch?     
 WhatsApp is a chat. Ordelo is a record. Every order lands in one place, the kitchen sees it, the customer gets updates on the spot, and you keep the customer relationship. 
 
 
  Won’t customers just use food apps?     
 They might discover you there. Ordelo is how you stop renting every order — your storefront, your margins, your data. 
 
 
  We’re a small café / new brand. Is this overkill?     
 Launch like a brand on day one. Start with menu, checkout, and notifications. Add kitchen display, multi-location, subscriptions, and automations when you’re ready. 
 
 
  Can it handle kitchen rush and multi-branch?     
 Yes. Busy mode pauses checkout gracefully, kitchen display keeps status clear, and Scale tiers add multi-location menus, hours, and branch reporting. 
 
 
  Can we sell more than food?     
 Yes. Digital downloads, gift vouchers, meal plans, coffee clubs, VIP memberships, and campaign landing pages — same customer relationship, more revenue lanes.
